objective: Add quoted-value support to Parse in internal/kv/kv.go while keeping every existing behavior unchanged. New rules: if the first non-space character after the first "=" of a segment is a double quote, the value is quoted. Inside a quoted value commas and "=" are literal, surrounding whitespace is preserved, the backslash sequences \" and \\ produce a literal quote and a literal backslash, and the enclosing quotes are removed. Anything after the closing quote up to the next comma is ignored. An unterminated quote consumes the rest of the input. A quote character anywhere else (in a key, or in the middle of an unquoted value) is an ordinary literal character.
acceptanceCriteria: all unquoted inputs parse exactly as before
